handler_table_installation: Ghidra shows FUN_804de938 reads interrupt-handler slot 8, clears alarm head/tail if the old entry is the default 0x804DF028, then calls FUN_804de708(8) with r4 still 0x804DF028; FUN_804de708 stores r4 into the indexed handler table.
wrapper_behavior: Bytes in sized body fn_804DF028 save registers/context and tail-branch (b, LK=0) to the exact entry 0x804DEDFC. This relative branch was not represented by prior Ghidra xrefs because the wrapper had no Ghidra function object.
interpretation: Prime exception vector dispatches through table slot 8 to wrapper 0x804DF028, which saves PPC OSContext and tail-branches to 0x804DEDFC. The handler receives the interrupt index and pointer loaded from low-memory 0xD4, following vector/wrapper register data flow. WiiCompiled ProcessAlarmQueue also reads 0x800000D4 for callback r4; that argument matches, but its queue base does not.
limitations: This proves static installation and call routing only; no decrementer interrupt was executed.
The host CpuContext/guest OSContext bridge, callback timing, scheduler effects, and first-screen rendering remain unvalidated.
